picks.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in September 2026?
picks.why: Inflation running above 3.5% would constrain Federal Reserve rate cuts and keep borrowing costs elevated for households and firms.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test whether taxing extreme fortunes raises revenue or drives capital and residents elsewhere.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption shapes energy prices, inflation, and growth worldwide.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership at the AI frontier affects which firms capture investment, talent, and the productivity gains from advanced models.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a major open math problem would signal research automation capable of accelerating scientific discovery and long-run growth.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: A trillion-dollar-plus AI listing would gauge investor conviction in AI economics and could reshape public equity markets.
